title: How a Godly Man Stays the Same Guy at the Office Happy Hour and in His Small Group
caption:
A godly man is the same guy at the office happy hour and in his small group. Nobody had to guess which version showed up.

You know the switch. It flips the second the office people can't see the church people, or the other way around. A double life doesn't split evenly. One version always wins, and it's usually the one nobody's watching.

If you wouldn't do it in front of your pastor, don't do it in front of your coworkers either. The line was never the audience. The line is the line. Keeping two versions of yourself straight is its own exhausting job. One man, wherever the room is, is lighter to carry.

The test of a godly man isn't the room. It's whether the room changes him.
